name: mybuddymaid
description: MyBuddyMaid — Next.js marketing/SEO site (next-app) plus the Vite booking app (app), served together under one origin.
//deploy: Vercel must build next-app: set the project's Root Directory to 'next-app'. There is deliberately no root vercel.json — the old one deployed the retired static site from app/dist. Run `npm run build:spa` whenever app/ changes, so the booking app embedded at next-app/public/_spa (served under /app/*) is current.
